description: List the connected account's personal folders with stable IDs and names. Use before filing an artifact; reuse a saved ID on later runs. Personal account required; operator credentials do not identify a personal library. These are flat personal labels, not shared permission containers.

share_token.description: Token from a user-provided share URL; carries only that share permission.

tenant_id.description: Destination tenant for creation; defaults to the account tenant.

name: artifact_site_folders
title: List my folders
